subject: PO token origins, spend cap sanity check and line-item corrections
messages:
From: Alex Carter <acarter@meridianpay.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@meridianpay.com, Sandeep Rao <srao@meridianpay.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T17:12:00Z
Subject: PO token origins, spend cap sanity check and line-item corrections

Hi Stephanie / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick intro today. We attached our completed vendor intake + PO request sheet to get MeridianPay set up in your system. A few items we want to confirm before you issue any provisional PO numbers:

- Spend cap: target is $150,000/month (we can start at $50k for the first 30 days while SOW completes). Can you advise how you map monthly caps into your provisional PO system?
- Line items: our intake has three separate SKUs but two of them should be collapsed into a single "Platform Usage" SKU (see rows 4/5 in the CSV). If they remain split, we'll exceed the per-line spend threshold and transactions will be blocked.
- PO token provenance: we need to understand the PO numbering flow (provisional vs final) so our finance team can match ledger entries to the right token.

Attached: vendor_intake_form.pdf, po_request_sheet.csv (see highlighted rows).

Can you confirm what information you need from us to: (1) provision a provisional PO, (2) set a temporary spend cap, and (3) apply the line-item collapse?

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Alex Carter
Head of Partnerships
MeridianPay

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (form), po_request_sheet.csv (vendor line items)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-06T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: PO token origins, spend cap sanity check and line-item corrections

Connor / Monica — looping you in on MeridianPay onboarding. Summary: external requests provisional PO + temporary spend cap (target $150k/mo, start at $50k for 30d) and wants two intake SKUs collapsed into a single line to avoid per-line blocking. They attached the intake which flags the rows to merge.

Immediate asks for procurement ops (Connor):
- Can we reserve a provisional PO token and map it to a temporary spend cap of $50,000 for the first 30 days, with a follow-up to scale to $150k after SOW and tax id?
- If we provisionally collapse the two SKUs into one line, what downstream ledger/chargebacks will be impacted? Is there a reconciliation step we'd need to run when the final PO is issued?

I've attached a short highlight file with the problematic CSV lines (intake_highlights.txt). If you need anything from Meridian (tax id, W9/CR), tell me and I'll request it.

Next step: Connor, please confirm provisional PO format and any required field changes. I'll coordinate with Alex for tax docs.

Thanks — Stephanie
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: intake_highlights.txt
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Alex Carter <acarter@meridianpay.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-07T18:15:00Z
Subject: Re: PO token origins, spend cap sanity check and line-item corrections

Hi all — thanks for the clear notes, Alex. Action/status below.

1) Provisional PO token: PON-2026-9876 (provisional). This token will allow ingestion into our activation pipeline while final SOW and tax docs are completed. PON-2026-9876 is tied to a temporary spend ceiling of $50,000 for the first 30 days from issuance.

2) Scaling: once we receive signed SOW and tax id (W-9 for US entities) we can increase the monthly cap to $150,000 and swap the provisional token for a final PO number. We'll run a ledger remap so transactions billed under PON-2026-9876 are attributed to the final PO. Expect that remap to be non-disruptive for downstream billing, but finance will receive an audit entry.

3) Line-item collapse: we can collapse SKUs SKU-PLTF-01 and SKU-PLTF-02 into a single line titled "Platform Usage" on the provisional PO. Please note the consequences:
   - Item-level tax codes will be applied at the collapsed-line level; if Meridian requires separate tax treatment for the two previous SKUs we need to know now.
   - Quantity aggregation will be by usage bucket; make sure your invoicing references the combined SKU.

4) Required corrections from Meridian (pre-finalization):
   - Confirm tax id (W-9) and remit-to address on company letterhead.
   - Update PO request CSV: change column "SKU_CODE" for rows 4/5 to "SKU-PLTF-01-COMB" and set quantity to "n/a" (usage-billing). See attached line_corrected.csv and po_assignment.csv.

Attachments: po_assignment.csv (provisional mapping), line_corrected.csv (recommended CSV edits).

Timeline: I can issue PON-2026-9876 now (which I've reserved), and we will execute the increase to $150k within 48 hours of receiving signed SOW + tax id. If you can get those today, we can fast-track.

Alex — please confirm you'll send the W-9 and a signed SOW. If you prefer, I can create a DocuSign link (will post it in the HubSpot deal).

Connor O'Brien
Manager, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: po_assignment.csv, line_corrected.csv
From: Alex Carter <acarter@meridianpay.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: Sandeep Rao <srao@meridianpay.com>, procurement@meridianpay.com
Date: 2026-12-08T00:47:00Z
Subject: Re: PO token origins, spend cap sanity check and line-item corrections

Thanks Connor / Stephanie — that all looks good. We'll:

- Upload W-9 and remit-to (PDF) to the Drive link you provided by EOD.
- Sign the SOW and send the signature back via DocuSign (please send the link if you set it up).
- Update our finance system to reference "SKU-PLTF-01-COMB" for billing going forward.

Confirming acceptance of provisional token PON-2026-9876 and the temporary $50k cap; we'll expedite docs to unlock the $150k monthly cap.

Appreciate the quick cadence — Alex
Head of Partnerships
MeridianPay
